text: Replaced the leaky water inlet valve. Water was leaking into the tub over a few days when the washer was not being used. I received a LG OEM part and it was easy to install. Great price and fixed the problem.

I was thrilled when receiving the hot and cold water inlet valve from Amazon. The part was forty dollars cheaper than from Appliance parts pros. I really was pretty happy when receiving the parts in two days! No longer have water filling the tub when the machine is off. I was shocked when I found the amount of sediment in the valves no wonder the part failed. I ordered screens and plan on cleaning them out annually instead of by the decade :)

Replaced the original LG unit. This one works and fits perfectly. Looks just the same as original. Been busing it now for about 6 months heavily and has not given me any trouble at all. And at a fraction of the dealers price, dont think twice about purchasing and installing this unit.
This replaced the original inlet valve/ solenoid assembly on my LG washing machine perfectly.  No issues at all.
This was just like the part I took off, but I could not verify that it was OEM.
Original lg should include dark cylinders and also a qr code showing part this is what i got. Buy know this is a after market part your purchasing. Will return.

I replaced the cold water solenoid on my 6 year old LG front loader washer use about 3 loads per week.  The tub was filling with water after the machine was off for several hours and needed to be drained via the pump drain hose on the lower front of the machine.  This part has slightly different markings than the original one but at half the cost that LG 'original part' I thought it was worth a try and so far at 4 weeks post installation no further water filling the tub while it is off.  I'm happy.

Unlike another seller with same-ish image, this one has the correct hose threading.  Installed this to fix the washer's original part where one solenoid stopped working.  This one has worked just fine for hot and cold washes.
Great replacement valve for my LG washer. Genuine part from LG

If you aren't sure about which one to order, you can ask LG online cutomer service chat for the part number. Be careful; they are not all the same size!

Received this the next day after ordering. The Amazon page confirmed that this Door Bin fit my model number LG refrigerator (and one of the reviewers also had the same model number and said it fit).  I had attempted to glue the one that cracked because of a too tall jar hitting the top of the door opening - lesson learned about confirming items in the bin will easily clear. The cracks in the bin botttom didn't "glue-up" all that well, so decided to just buy a replacement and was happy to see when this arrived that it is a perfect LG replacement, with the same MAN626084 part number on the bottom as the one it replaces.  Pulled the cracked one up and out and the new one snapped in exactly the same, as expected.

I easily found and replaced this shelf but there was no replacement for the narrower one at the lower level.  The original has a weakness when the owner closes the door repeatedly by pulling on the shelf which is easier to grab.  The original shelf can't take the strain because there is a seam at the stress point.  That's poor design.  I know that I should use the handle but it is an unconscious method of closing the door.  I hope this one holds up better and I am more conscious now of the need to avoid using the shelf as if it were a handle.
